scope: Mixed APDU encodings continue bounded WebUSB/NDEF input; NFC extended MSG resets old FIDO input under CLA80/90.
mapping: C WebUSB validates its bounded envelope before process_apdu_from. Extended encoding does not bypass fido_apdu_input or NDEF UPDATE continuation. Runtime no longer imposes an active-command-chain admission ban. Existing transport owner, output-busy, SELECT and per-applet allows_extended policies remain; PIV still rejects extended frames and CCID rejects before routing.

C NFC dispatch masks only the chaining bit when recognizing proprietary MSG and resets fido_capdu input on every extended encoding. Runtime now uses Header.unchained for the same discriminator. Inline CLA90/Case2E can start a fresh semantic request. Large PKE staging still requires exact CLA80 and remains unchanged; no larger transport/request buffer is introduced.

The generator derives literal semantics from C src/apdu.c and NDEF selector/write cursor, not from outputs.461 cases include both transports, four envelope forms, six prefix splits, intermediate/final fragments, finite Le continuation,255/256/279-byte inline bodies, actual NDEF readback, CCID extended rejection and fresh-request cleanup.267 old failures are repaired.

The first NDEF fixture used the wrong message EF identifierE104. C and Rust both correctly rejected it. The corrected fixture uses0001 from pinned C ndef_select and its CC declaration. Initial failed vectors/reports remain archived and do not count as production defects. The final461-case report is authoritative.
